subject.title: Agents page: dropdown selector causes too much friction, should show agent list directly

question: Should the Agents page keep the dropdown-first desktop selector, replace it with a visible desktop agent list/sidebar with mobile dropdown fallback, or use another navigation pattern?
rationale: Current main still implements dropdown-first navigation, while the proof-supplied visible-list PR was closed unmerged; automation should not choose the permanent Control UI layout without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt desktop visible list
options.body: Land or replace the prior visible-list approach with responsive desktop rows/sidebar and keep the dropdown as the narrow-screen fallback.

options.title: Keep dropdown-first navigation
options.body: Close the remaining UX request as not planned after documenting that the dropdown is the intended Agents page pattern.

options.title: Request a different design
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer specifies a denser sidebar, table, hybrid selector, or other layout direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt desktop visible list
recommendation.body: Land or replace the prior visible-list approach with responsive desktop rows/sidebar and keep the dropdown as the narrow-screen fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: This is now a Control UI product/design choice, and steipete has adjacent Agents config-save history plus broad product-routing signal in this area.
